title: A reply that lands after the person left its thread saves nothing, but reopening that thread shows the reply as if it had saved
evidence: Fable ruled 2026-11-12 on PR 1306: a reply arriving after an A to B thread switch applies nothing, valid edits included. Condition: thread A must not later read as if it saved. The "Not saved" words today are a banner only (RECORD_CHANGED_SINCE_ASKED, now in packages/health-core/src/erase.ts:92), not stored on the turn (widget-src/src/lib/chat-api.ts:35 ChatMessage has no such field), so reopening A shows the reply's words with no marker. Wanted: store the marker on that turn so reopening A shows "Not saved: you opened another conversation before this reply arrived." Same for the iPhone (parity). Fits the chat-turn reducer (chat-turn.ts).
